title: Severe Infection & Sepsis Assessment
description: Davolash ishi bo'yicha Og'ir infeksiya va sepsis baholash mavzusida klinik muloqot va tibbiy ingliz tili darsi.
scenario_prompt: You are a virtual patient presenting with symptoms related to Severe Infection & Sepsis Assessment. Speak in natural, everyday patient English.

patient_profile.history: Patient presents with complaints of severe infection & sepsis assessment.

grammar.title: Clinical Grammar Focus
grammar.rule_explanation: Klinik muloqotda aniq grammatik qoidalar bemor holatini to'g'ri baholashga yordam beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_uz: Klinik muloqotda aniq grammatik qoidalar bemor holatini to'g'ri baholashga yordam beradi.
grammar.rule_explanation_ru: В клиническом диалоге точные грамматические структуры помогают быстрее понять жалобы пациента.
grammar.rule_explanation_en: Using precise clinical grammatical structures enables clear patient history taking and assessment.
grammar.structure_pattern: Subject + is / was + being + V3 | Subject + has been diagnosed with + Condition

examples.sentence: How long has this symptom been bothering you?
examples.translation: Bu simptom sizni qancha vaqtdan beri bezovta qilmoqda?
examples.translation_uz: Bu simptom sizni qancha vaqtdan beri bezovta qilmoqda?
examples.translation_ru: Как долго вас беспокоит этот симптом?

examples.sentence: Does the pain get worse with hot or cold temperatures?
examples.translation: Og'riq issiq yoki sovuq haroratda kuchayadimi?
examples.translation_uz: Og'riq issiq yoki sovuq haroratda kuchayadimi?
examples.translation_ru: Усиливается ли боль от горячего или холодного?

common_mistakes.incorrect: Since when you feel this pain?
common_mistakes.correct: How long have you had this pain?
common_mistakes.explanation: Davomiylikni so'rashda 'How long have you had...?' standarti ishlatiladi.
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: Davomiylikni so'rashda 'How long have you had...?' standarti ishlatiladi.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: Для выяснения длительности используется конструкция 'How long have you had...?'.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Use 'How long have you had...?' when asking about the duration of symptoms.

common_mistakes.correct: Where exactly do you feel the pain?
common_mistakes.explanation: Lokatsiyani aniqlashda 'Where do you feel the pain?' to'g'ri grammatik shakl.
common_mistakes.explanation_uz: Lokatsiyani aniqlashda 'Where do you feel the pain?' to'g'ri grammatik shakl.
common_mistakes.explanation_ru: Правильный вопрос о локализации боли: 'Where exactly do you feel the pain?'.
common_mistakes.explanation_en: Ask 'Where exactly do you feel the pain?' to identify the specific anatomical site.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: How long have you been feeling unwell?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: I've been feeling progressively weaker for about two days. I've also been having repeated episodes of fever and chills.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Have you been coughing or experiencing any urinary symptoms?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: I've had a cough with yellow sputum, and I've been feeling short of breath. Relative: He became much more confused this morning and almost fainted when he stood up. Nurse: His temperature is 39.2°C, blood pressure is 88 over 54, pulse 122, respiratory rate 28, and oxygen saturation is 90% on room air.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Thank you. These observations are concerning. Have you been treated for an infection recently?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes. I was treated for a chest infection last week.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Were antibiotics prescribed?

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Yes, but I stopped them after three days because I started feeling better.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. At the moment, we need to consider a severe systemic infection and possible sepsis.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Is sepsis life-threatening?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: It can be. The important thing is that it is recognised and treated promptly. Nurse: Blood cultures can be taken before antibiotics are started, provided this does not cause a significant delay.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Exactly. Blood samples will be taken for cultures, full blood count, renal function, electrolytes, lactate, and other relevant tests.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Will I need oxygen?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your oxygen saturation is low, so supplemental oxygen will be given and your response will be monitored closely. Relative: Does he need to go to intensive care?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: We'll assess his response to initial treatment. If his blood pressure remains low or organ dysfunction develops, higher-level care may be required. Nurse: Intravenous access has been established. I'm preparing the prescribed fluids and medications.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good. Appropriate antimicrobial treatment should be started promptly if a serious bacterial infection is suspected.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: Will the doctors know which antibiotic is best immediately?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Not always. Treatment may begin empirically and then be adjusted when culture results identify the organism and its sensitivities.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.text: What should I expect over the next few hours?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Your blood pressure, urine output, oxygenation, mental state, and laboratory markers will be monitored closely. We'll reassess you repeatedly rather than relying on a single measurement. Relative: So the situation is serious, but you are treating it now?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Yes. The priority is to control the infection, support your vital organs, and identify the source as quickly as possible.

tests.question: What is the medical meaning of the term 'severe infection' in clinical consultation?
tests.explanation: 'severe infection' atamasining to'g'ri ma'nosi: og'ir infeksiya.

tests.question: Which term corresponds to 'isitma va titroq'?
tests.explanation: 'isitma va titroq' ma'nosiga mos keluvchi tibbiy termin 'fever and chills' hisoblanadi.

tests.question: Which of the following is the grammatically and clinically standard question to ask about the duration of symptoms?
tests.option_a: How long do you having this symptom?
tests.option_b: How long has this condition been bothering you?
tests.option_c: Since what time you have this problem?
tests.option_d: How many days you are feeling pain?
tests.explanation: Klinik anamnezda davomiylikni so'rash uchun Present Perfect Continuous ('How long has... been bothering you?') to'g'ri shakl hisoblanadi.

tests.question: When evaluating acute pain, what is the best phrasing to assess pain character?
tests.option_a: Is your pain bad or very bad?
tests.option_b: Can you describe the pain—is it sharp, dull, throbbing, or aching?
tests.option_c: Why do you have sharp pain today?
tests.explanation: Og'riq xarakterini aniqlashda shifokor ochiq va taklif qiluvchi variantlar (sharp, dull, throbbing, aching) beradi.
